title: Secret Scanning
brief: **Ticket:** a key may be committed in the repo. Find it, and name the tool that automates this.
theory:
## Secret scanning
Finds credentials in code and git history; a committed secret lives forever in history and must be rotated. Tools: **gitleaks**, TruffleHog, detect-secrets. Run in CI to fail the build on a hit.
worked_example:
```
$ gitleaks detect --no-git
RuleID: aws-access-key  File: config.py  Line: 12
```

knowledge_check.q: A committed secret must be ___ (it stays in git history)
Secret scanning runs best in the ___ so leaks fail the build

investigation.intro: Find the hardcoded secret in the lab app.
steps: The grep finds the committed signing key.

capture.task: **Name the tool.** A popular free tool that scans a repo for committed secrets (one word).
